t: This is Cadogan Hall, a concert hall on Sloane Terrace in Chelsea, with seating for 953 people. It was designed by Robert Chisholm, an English architect who worked mainly in India. Chisholm pioneered the Indo-Saracenic style of architecture in Madras, so he's a surprising name to find attached to a Chelsea building. The material I have is thin beyond that, so I'll simply say that the hall you're looking at came from the drawing board of someone whose reputation was made far from London.
